scope: Primary source register for chapters 01/02. Full means full page text available to author, not copied locally. Text means relevant official indexed documentation text was read; dynamically rendered Apple pages may expose only a JavaScript shell on direct opening. API availability and runtime support remain W00 gates.

sources.title: Meet Object Capture for iOS — WWDC23
sources.claim: Guided capture and reconstruction are distinct phases; support and scene suitability matter.
sources.limitations: Presentation is not evidence of performance on user hardware.

sources.title: ObjectCaptureSession.isSupported
sources.claim: Gate ObjectCapture using runtime capability support.
sources.limitations: Recheck SDK availability; direct page may require JavaScript.

sources.title: RoomCaptureSession.isSupported
sources.claim: Room capture availability is checked on the executing device.
sources.limitations: Not a universal OS-version-only guarantee.

sources.title: Video device not available in background
sources.claim: Capture lifecycle must handle background camera interruption.
sources.limitations: AVFoundation reason does not itself specify an ARKit callback signature.

sources.title: TN2445 Handling Frame Drops with AVCaptureVideoDataOutput
sources.claim: Long processing and retained buffers cause capture pressure; bounded queues are justified.
sources.limitations: AVFoundation technical note; ARKit adapters need separate profiling.

sources.title: Improve Core ML integration with async prediction — WWDC23
sources.claim: Asynchronous prediction permits bounded concurrent work; throughput depends on workload.
sources.limitations: No deterministic GPU execution order or latency guarantee.

sources.title: Swift TaskGroup
sources.claim: Structured child task lifetime and cooperative cancellation require explicit cancellation handling.
sources.limitations: Task is not a dedicated CPU thread.

sources.title: AprilRobotics AprilTag
sources.claim: Marker pose requires calibrated intrinsics and physical tag size.
sources.limitations: Pose quality must be measured; license and commit pinning required.

sources.title: OpenCV Perspective-n-Point pose computation
sources.claim: PnP estimates object-to-camera transformation using correspondences; geometric configuration can yield multiple solutions.
sources.limitations: Documented solver does not establish robust identification of arbitrary objects.

sources.title: Open3D ICP registration tutorial
sources.claim: Local ICP refinement requires suitable initialization and geometric overlap.
sources.limitations: Offline reference; no assumption of an available iOS package.

sources.title: ARFrame.sceneDepth
sources.claim: Depth access is a frame capability and may be unavailable.
sources.limitations: Resolution and cadence are observed at runtime; no fixed value promised.

sources.title: ARDepthData.confidenceMap
sources.claim: Depth confidence categories guide filtering.
sources.limitations: Categorical confidence is not a calibrated millimetre uncertainty.

sources.title: RoomPlan
sources.claim: RoomPlan supports structured room capture with parametric scene representation.
sources.limitations: Not a certification of construction tolerances or complete BIM.

sources.title: Scanning the rooms of a single structure
sources.claim: Multiple rooms need a coherent AR session/relocalization workflow.
sources.limitations: Session continuity does not eliminate drift or establish ground truth.

sources.title: URLSessionWebSocketTask
sources.claim: Foundation WebSocket supports asynchronous messages over TCP/TLS.
sources.limitations: Transport has no hard real-time guarantee.

sources.title: URLSessionWebSocketTask.maximumMessageSize
sources.claim: Incoming WebSocket message size must be bounded.
sources.limitations: Application also limits parsed metadata and binary payload assembly.

sources.title: ARMeshAnchor
sources.claim: Scene mesh updates are not guaranteed to reflect environment movements in real time.
sources.limitations: Not suitable as sole collision safety sensor.

sources.title: SQLite Foreign Key Support
sources.claim: Foreign key enforcement is explicitly enabled and verified per connection.
sources.limitations: File existence and content hashes are outside foreign key enforcement.

sources.title: SQLite Write-Ahead Logging
sources.claim: WAL concurrency and recovery depend on connection/filesystem behavior; current documentation identifies the WAL-reset bug and fixed versions.
sources.limitations: No assertion about the SQLite version bundled with the user's iOS. Initial design chooses DELETE journal.

sources.title: SQLite PRAGMA synchronous
sources.claim: Synchronization mode is an explicit durability/performance choice.
sources.limitations: FULL does not create a distributed transaction with external CAS files.

sources.title: iPhone 17 Pro Max Technical Specifications
sources.claim: Reference device has A19 Pro, LiDAR and USB 3 capability up to advertised 10 Gb/s.
sources.limitations: Link bandwidth does not guarantee application throughput. Regional weight variants exist; mounted unit must be weighed.
